sentences.text: Parabacteroides merdae was reclassified out of Bacteroides when 16S ribosomal RNA analysis showed that it did not belong in that genus.
Its beta-glucuronidase is an abundant enzyme of its type in Human Microbiome Project gut metagenomes; such enzymes can affect drug efficacy and toxicity.
A cysteine peptidase of the clostripain family from this gut bacterium provided the first crystal structure for that peptidase family.
In mice, live bacteria degraded branched-chain amino acids through the porA gene and reduced atherosclerotic lesions on a high-fat diet.
